cases.prompt: Can someone who only uses a keyboard or a screen reader get through checkout in packages/web? Review the checkout components and tell me what would stop them.
Is there a bug in how CheckoutForm.tsx in packages/web handles a failed submit? Look only at the submit logic and tell me.

I added a quantity stepper to packages/web; it is staged, not committed. Before I open the PR, check whether people who use only a keyboard or a screen reader can use it, and list what fails with the criterion for each problem.
cases.review: The answer reviews the staged QuantityStepper.tsx and QuantityStepper.css and reports, each with severity, path:line, the WCAG 2.2 criterion by number and name, who is blocked and a fix: the div controls with click handlers only (2.1.1 Keyboard, 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value; Critical, since keyboard users cannot change the quantity), the icons without text alternatives (1.1.1), the 16-pixel targets (2.5.8), the value text at about 2.2:1 on white (1.4.3) and the removed outline (2.4.7). It lists what it could not check without running the UI, installs no tool, and changes no file.
